non-blocking: keep_incumbent=False is the load-bearing fix for the stalled lanes, but no CPU test fails if it is flipped back to True; the policy is guarded only by the H200 incumbent-head receipt (incumbent-head.log, EXIT=1 on lanes 10 and 13 at 60 updates), which is not part of any runnable gate.
